C1_same_null_model.argument: dEmax uses Bliss independence as expected response (Jaaks quote above); among the six DrugComb candidates only synergy_bliss is constructed from the Bliss independence reference (NAR2021 + SynergyFinder R/Bliss.R).

C2_same_orientation.argument: dEmax = Bliss Emax - combination Emax (positive = combination more effective); DrugComb: positive synergy score suggests synergy (NAR2021). Same sign convention.

C3_convertible_scale.argument: dEmax is on the viability fraction scale (threshold 0.2 = 20% viability shift); DrugComb synergy scores are in percentage-inhibition points (Malyutina 2019); x100 converts dEmax to the DrugComb scale.

C4_documented_differences: the summary synergy score is a dose-matrix summary (mean over the matrix / landscape), while dEmax is a fitted efficacy contrast between observed and expected response at the highest tested concentration: not the same statistic (aggregation/potency content differs)
Jaaks screen is an anchored 2x7 design; DrugComb blocks pool studies with different dose-matrix designs (2x2 ... 10x10) and v1.4 carries no study/design column
Jaaks uses fitted curve parameters (Emax) and replicate nesting; DrugComb uses SynergyFinder matrix scores and 93.2% of curated data points have no replicates (NAR2021)
DrugComb summary block = one experiment/dose matrix; dEmax is one formula per (anchor concentration, library, cell line) tuple
comparability.equivalence_not_claimable: no entity-level response pairing exists between DrugComb and the project Jaaks table (cells 18, drugs 40, unit keys 241 overlap; different designs), so ONLY construct/null-model/sign/scale comparability is argued; no numerical equivalence claim.

jaaks_averaging_replicates.quote: Drug responses were averaged across technical and biological replicates

jaaks_bliss_expected_product.quote: every point on the Bliss dose response curve is defined as the product between the anchor viability and the corresponding point on the library dose response curve

jaaks_delta_emax_definition.quote: Shifts in potency (∆IC 50 ) and in efficacy (∆ E max ) were calculated as the difference between the observed combination response and expected Bliss

jaaks_emax_at_highest_conc.quote: E max is reported at the highest tested concentration for the drug

malyutina_css_scale.quote: The CSS for the foreground drug is defined as a percentage which varies between 0 and 100

malyutina_same_unit.quote: utilize the same unit as the percentage of inhibition of cell viability. Therefore, the synergy score can be interpreted as the extra percentage inhibition effect beyond the expectation

nar2021_bliss_independence.quote: the Bliss model assumes probabilistic independence when drugs are non-interactive while the Loewe model assumes that the efficacy of non-synergistic drug combinations is identical to that of a drug combined with itself

nar2021_four_models.quote: For evaluating the drug synergy, we implement four major mathematical models including Bliss, Loewe, HSA and ZIP
nar2021_four_models.source: NAR 2021 gkab438 (PMC8218202), "Algorithms for assessing sensitivity and synergy"

nar2021_qc_range.quote: less than −200% or larger than 200%, were marked as poor-quality data points

nar2021_sign_convention.quote: Drug combinations with synergy scores of zero are considered additive, while a positive synergy score suggests synergy, and a negative score suggests antagonism

nar2021_summary_table_block.quote: a unique identifier, termed block id, is needed to differentiate the same drug combination—cell line pair that has been repeated in multiple experiments

nar2021_zip_combines.quote: The ZIP model, on the other hand, can be considered as an Ensembl model as it combines the assumptions of Bliss and Loewe

synergyfinder_average_title.quote: the mean value of all scores in the selected ranges

jaaks_scale_reference.definition: Jaaks 2022 Methods: dEmax = Bliss Emax - combination Emax, on the viability scale (threshold 0.2 = 20% shift); Emax reported at the highest tested concentration of the fitted curves.

judgment.aggregation_rule: arithmetic mean of block-level synergy_bliss within (cell_line_name normalized, unordered normalized drug pair); blocks with non-missing value, at least 1 block
conditions: endpoint shows strong study/design-proxy heterogeneity (eta^2(study proxy, assigned)=0.08685; including unassigned=0.116485; flag threshold 0.10): blocks come from heterogeneous dose-matrix designs (2x2 ... 10x10) and v1.4 has no study/design column, so this is an unadjustable confound that must be disclosed and handled in stage 2 (e.g. study/segment stratified sensitivity)
judgment.no_metric_switch_note: PROTOCOL_PB section 12.2: switching to synergy_zip/hsa/loewe/S/css because the primary fails is prohibited (construct-inferior for dEmax comparability) and would be recorded as endpoint_not_usable + metric_switch_prohibited.
judgment.power_check_note: empirical reject rate of the one-sided rho>1.96*SE(two-way) test at the given effect, simulated on the fixed evaluation units; it validates the normal MDE approximation and is not an effect estimate
reopen_conditions_for_stage_2: if the Lead amends delta_min in the stage-2 protocol with an explicit justification (e.g. delta_min = the frozen headline magnitude 0.1183 or half of it 0.059): under this design MDE80(two-way)=0.115, so a delta_min >= 0.115 would pass; this is a protocol amendment decision, not an auditor decision
increase the number of independent drug pairs/cells in the both-unseen design; r=0.40 gives MDE80(two-way)=0.061, still above 0.03

a raw dose-level refit (2,008,117,325 B) would change the endpoint construct but not the evaluation-unit count; its power gain is unknown and requires a separate frozen protocol + download budget approval
judgment.verdict_interpretation: failure is power/design (evaluation_cannot_distinguish) at the pre-registered delta_min, NOT endpoint saturation and NOT construct mismatch: the primary endpoint passes the saturation, aggregation and comparability gates

diagnostic_decomposition.note: post-pre-registration diagnostic decomposition; the pre-registered gate remains the two-way cluster bootstrap MDE80 (PROTOCOL_PB section 11/12)

redundancy.pre_probe_reconciliation: R191 Lead pre-probe (reference only) reported block-level bliss-zip 0.920 and bliss-hsa 0.801; the corresponding Pearson block values are reported here for reconciliation. The pre-registered endpoint selection uses Spearman (rank) redundancy, which is the criterion stated in PROTOCOL_PB section 7.

matrix_size_test.caveat: matrix sizes are paper-reported (S1); the actual SynergyFinder input convention per study is not verifiable from the summary table
matrix_size_test.window_quality_filter: only study windows whose v1.4 cell-line count equals the paper S1 cell-line count are used (mixed windows excluded)

unassigned_blocks.caveat: study windows are min/max block_id of each study in the 4.22% v1.5 byte sample; they are lower bounds on the true study ranges, so a v1.4 block can be left unassigned or be near a window boundary. The study labels are a proxy, not a v1.4 study column (v1.4 has none).
